name: Health record
duplicates: Health is drawn three times in the old Figma: in Inspection (健康 - add and remove disease or symptom), in the pig list (health management) and in the 健康与治疗 treatment file. This feature holds the one version built in the Inspection prototype.

entryPoints.label: A pig with a condition in the walk
entryPoints.control: A pig row with health tags

entryPoints.label: Attention row or health tag on the pig record
A Health task (vaccination, treatment) on a pig

addsTo.what: Health actions (Disease or symptom, Record treatment, Resolve conditions, Care instructions)
Health tags with care icon on every pig row

flow: Save: the finding appears as a row or tag

screens.name: Pig with open conditions and an ongoing one
screens.zh: 健康 · 需处理与持续

notes.purpose: Read a pig's health on the spot: what needs attention now (Fever, Poor appetite) and what is only recorded (Arthritis). Sow 000306 is the example; the sheet is her pig record viewed for health.
states: Needs-attention rows plus an ongoing tag in General details (this screen).
Only ongoing conditions: health-record.ongoing.
No condition: no rows and Health reads "—".

elements.name: Attention row · type
elements.logic: Fixed type word on each condition row (a pig note row reads "Note").

elements.name: Attention row · title
elements.logic: The condition name.

elements.name: Attention row · detail
elements.logic: Care label (left out when None) then "Day N" - day of the condition, counted from the recorded start.

elements.name: Attention row · colour and chevron
elements.logic: Class from the care level: hospital, treatment, monitor; chevron opens the finding.

elements.name: Health row in General details
elements.logic: Ongoing conditions (care "No action needed") as tags with "N days"; opens the condition. The row scrolls sideways when it does not fit.

elements.name: Temperature
elements.logic: A plain reading; no link to Fever and no flag.

elements.name: Last treatment
elements.logic: Shown under the attention rows once a treatment is recorded.

controls.control: An attention row or a health tag

edge: A pig note appears as a "Note" row among the health rows and opens the log, not a finding.
A dead sow keeps her conditions but cannot be changed.
rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS, "Unified care").
Human-entered records lead; derived plans and stable facts stay in reading sections.
issues: The word "Health" is the type on every attention row, the label of the Health row below and the name of an Actions group: three meanings on one screen.
Duration is written two ways: "Day 2" for a condition needing attention and "120 days" for an ongoing one; same fact, two formats.
The same conditions appear in the walk row tags, in these rows and (ongoing) in General details: the care level is stated in words only here.
No sign here that treatment was or was not given for Fever; "Last treatment" is absent until one is recorded.
A temperature of 39.5 sits in General details far below the Fever row.

notes.purpose: A condition that is recorded but needs no action: sow 000281 has Arthritis (120 days, "Condition recorded. No action needed.").
states: No needs-attention rows; the condition appears only as a tag in General details.

elements.name: Health row
elements.logic: Ongoing tag in the grid, not an alert; opens the condition.

elements.name: Walk row tag
elements.logic: Same tag on the walk list; counts in the Health lens.

edge: A condition stays visible until it is explicitly resolved.
rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS, "Unified care").
"A condition with No action needed remains recorded and visible in the health tags until explicitly resolved."
issues: A pig with nothing to do still counts in the walk's Health lens and the pen map "N health", so the count does not mean work.

screens.name: Pig with several ongoing conditions
screens.zh: 健康 · 多个持续状况

notes.purpose: How a long list of ongoing conditions fits: Arthritis (120 days), Lameness (45 days), Coughing (30 days).
states: Tags sit in one row that scrolls sideways.

elements.name: Health row
elements.shows: Arthritis · 120 days, Lameness · 45 days, Coughing · 30 days
elements.logic: Region with keyboard focus, each tag its own button; accessible name "name · N days · View condition".

elements.name: Walk row tags
elements.logic: On the list the extra tags collapse into +N.

issues: A sideways-scrolling row hides conditions two and three from a glance, yet these are the ones with the longest history.

notes.purpose: Shows the four care levels as they read on the walk list: the same Diarrhoea tag on 000801 now carries Move to hospital pen.
states: No action needed (neutral note icon) · Monitor (eye icon) · Treat in place (syringe icon) · Move to hospital pen (hospital icon).

elements.name: Tag icon and colour
elements.logic: Class and icon from the care level: care-ongoing, care-monitor, care-treatment, care-hospital. The care words are only in the tooltip and in the row's accessible name.

elements.name: Tag sort
elements.logic: On a row, conditions needing attention are listed before ongoing ones.

rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS, "Unified care").
issues: The preset opens the same text as the walk; the care level differs only by icon and colour, which a screenshot of text does not show.
Hospital pen is a care choice only: nothing moves the pig to a hospital pen.

notes.purpose: One condition on one pig: its care, note, treatment and the ways to change or close it. How to reach it: a needs-attention row or a health tag on the pig record.
states: Linked to feed (body condition: Thin): extra line and a Review feed adjustment row.
Not linked: the three rows only.
Closed or removed meanwhile: "Finding closed - The record is retained in this pig's log."

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Condition name; ear tag, kind (Disease, Symptom, Body condition) and day count.

elements.name: Care
elements.logic: Care label of the condition and the note beneath when there is one.

elements.name: Recorded line
elements.logic: Date and author; "—" for either when missing (the seeded Thin reads "Recorded — · —").

elements.name: Feed link note
elements.shows: Linked feed adjustment: +10%. Resolving this finding restores the base plan.
elements.logic: Only for body-condition findings tied to a feed adjustment.

elements.name: Latest treatment
elements.shows: Latest treatment: medicine · dose unit · method
elements.logic: Only when the pig's last treatment targeted this condition.

elements.name: Row · Edit finding
elements.logic: Always.

elements.name: Row · Record treatment
elements.logic: Opens the treatment form with the condition fixed.

elements.name: Row · Review feed adjustment
elements.logic: Only when linked to feed; opens the feed editor.

elements.name: Row · Resolve or remove
elements.logic: Always.

controls.does: opens the feed editor for the pig

edge: Back returns to the entry page; saved changes keep the sheet on the finding.
rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS, "Unified care").
Recovery keeps the case in history; entered in error marks it as a correction.
issues: "Recorded — · —" shows empty dashes where the date and author are unknown.
The day count is stored at 1 when a finding is recorded and never advances in the prototype; "Day 2" and "120 days" are sample numbers.
Four rows for one record; Edit finding (care, note) and Resolve or remove both change the finding.

notes.purpose: Rename the condition, change its care and add a note. How to reach it: Finding, Edit finding.
states: Body-condition finding linked to feed: the name is fixed and the text says "Use Review feed adjustment to change the condition band."
Other findings: a picker of every catalogue name the pig does not already carry.

elements.name: Finding
elements.logic: Picker of catalogue names; a name already on the pig is not offered.

elements.name: Care
elements.shows: No action needed · Monitor · Treat in place · Move to hospital pen
elements.logic: Select picker.

elements.name: Note · optional
elements.logic: Free text.

elements.name: Save changes
elements.logic: Writes the new name, kind, care and note; log entry "Finding edited" with "old → new · old care → new care".

controls.does: saves and returns to the finding

edge: A linked treatment target is renamed with the finding.
rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS, "Unified care").
issues: The finding's start date and author cannot be corrected here.

notes.purpose: Close one finding as Recovered or Entered in error. How to reach it: Finding, Resolve or remove.
states: Linked to feed: "This also ends the linked feed adjustment and returns this pig to the base plan."

elements.name: Outcome
elements.logic: Select picker, default Recovered.

elements.name: Note · optional
elements.logic: Kept with the closed case.

elements.name: Explanation
elements.shows: The finding leaves the active list. Its record and this change remain in the pig's log.
elements.logic: Fixed.

elements.name: Save outcome
elements.logic: Moves the case to the pig's closed cases, ends a linked feed adjustment (factor back to 1), logs "Recovered" or "Finding entered in error", returns to the pig record.

controls.does: saves and returns to the pig record

edge: No second confirmation for Entered in error.
rules: Recovery keeps the case in history; entered in error marks a correction.
issues: Two names for the same thing: "Resolve or remove" here, "Resolve conditions" in Actions.

notes.purpose: Add one or more diseases or symptoms to one pig or many in one move. How to reach it: Actions, Health, Disease or symptom (one pig or several).
states: One pig: a Details panel only (no pig list).
Several pigs: a list of the pigs above the Details panel, each row with a checkbox, a preview and a state.
Details collapsed or open (toggle).
Save disabled until a condition is chosen and at least one row would change.

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Count of selected pigs; one pig shows "ear tag · pen".

elements.name: Row preview
elements.shows: Add Fever · No action needed / Already recorded · unchanged / Choose conditions
elements.logic: Per pig: conditions that would be added with the care label, or "Already recorded - unchanged" if she already has all of them, or the prompt.

elements.name: Row checkbox
elements.logic: Unticking excludes the pig (row reads "Excluded").

elements.name: Choose conditions
elements.shows: summary of the chosen names or "Choose conditions"
elements.logic: Button that opens the catalogue picker.

elements.name: Care
elements.logic: Select picker; the same care is given to every added condition.

elements.name: Add note chip
elements.logic: Opens a note editor; the note is stored with each added condition.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: N = pigs that would change. Writes one finding per pig and name, day 1, recorded date 12 Sep 2026, by G. Hansen, and one log entry "Health recorded".

controls.does: saves, clears the selection and returns to the walk list

edge: A condition the pig already has is skipped and keeps its original start date.
Care default is No action needed, so a newly recorded Fever does not need attention unless the worker changes Care.
rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS, "Unified care").
One searchable disease/symptom catalogue for one or many pigs (HEALTH-MANAGEMENT).
Existing cases keep their original start date.
issues: The default Care "No action needed" makes the quickest path (choose Fever, Save) record a fever as a non-alert; the first screen does not ask the worker to think about care.
The Save label reads "Save · 0 pigs" while disabled.
The catalogue starts on Symptoms and needs two taps to reach a symptom; a gloved worker faces three levels (tab, door, item).

notes.purpose: Search or browse the disease and symptom catalogue and tick one or more. How to reach it: Record health, Choose conditions.
states: Tabs Diseases | Symptoms (default Symptoms).
Category doors with counts; inside a category the items with checkboxes.
Search: results grouped by category, plus "Add “name”" when nothing matches exactly.
Custom item: asks for its category, then can be removed with an x.
"N selected" folded list when something is ticked.

elements.name: Disease doors
elements.shows: 9 categories (Respiratory, Gastrointestinal, Reproductive and neonatal, Skin and external, Nervous system, Systemic, Musculoskeletal, Nutritional and metabolic, Other)
elements.logic: Each shows its disease count and "N selected".

elements.name: Symptom doors
elements.shows: General appearance · Limbs · Tail · Head and neck · Eyes · Ears · Nose · Mouth · Skin · Body system
elements.logic: Body areas are separate doors; Body system opens one page with Urinary, Respiratory, Digestive and Reproductive groups.

elements.name: Item row
elements.logic: Checkbox; detail line shows "Custom · category" and how many selected pigs already carry it.

elements.name: Search
elements.logic: Matches name, category, section and aliases (e.g. PRRS, pig flu), case-insensitive.

elements.name: Done
elements.logic: Keeps the choice. Back discards the changes made in the picker.

controls.does: returns to Record health with the choice

edge: A typed name that is not in the catalogue can be added as a custom disease or symptom and placed under a chosen category; custom items are kept for the session.
The disease and symptom hierarchy was translated from the Figma file.
rules: Diseases and symptoms are one catalogue and one picker (HEALTH-MANAGEMENT).
issues: "Link condition" (for a treatment) reuses this catalogue with another layout, so there are two near-identical pickers.
No recently used or common list: a frequent condition sits two doors deep each time.

notes.purpose: Change the care level (and add a note) for a chosen condition across the selected pigs. How to reach it: Actions, Health, Care instructions (one or many pigs), or Edit conditions (several pigs).
states: Titled "Care instructions" or "Edit conditions": the same form and rows, only the title and the log entry differ ("Triage updated" / "Finding edited").
Condition not chosen: each row lists that pig's conditions or "No open conditions".
Condition chosen: rows read "Thin · Monitor → Treat in place" or "No Thin · unchanged".

elements.name: Condition
elements.logic: Picker of the condition names found on the selected pigs.

elements.name: Care
elements.shows: Keep current care (default) · No action needed · Monitor · Treat in place · Move to hospital pen
elements.logic: Keep current care leaves each pig's own level.

elements.name: Row preview
elements.shows: Thin · Monitor → Treat in place · Note updated
elements.logic: Per pig: care change and note change; "Unchanged" when equal.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: N = changed pigs.

controls.does: saves and returns to the list

edge: Pigs without that condition are shown and left unchanged.
rules: Care is the only editable condition state: No action needed, Monitor, Treat in place, Move to hospital pen. A condition needs attention for every choice except No action needed (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS, "Unified care").
Bulk: Keep current care preserves each pig's existing choice.
issues: Two Actions rows (Edit conditions, Care instructions) open the same form under two titles; a third (Edit finding) edits the same record for one pig.

notes.purpose: Recover or correct one chosen condition across the selected pigs. How to reach it: Actions, Health, Resolve conditions.
states: Condition and Outcome (Recovered | Entered in error) chosen: rows read "Thin → Recovered"; before the outcome: "Thin · choose outcome".

elements.name: Condition
elements.logic: Names found on the selected pigs.

elements.name: Outcome
elements.logic: Recovered or Entered in error.

elements.name: Row preview
elements.logic: Pigs without the condition are "No X · unchanged".

elements.name: Row note
elements.logic: For feed-linked body-condition findings.

elements.name: Save
elements.logic: Closes each case, logs "Recovered" or "Record corrected".

controls.does: saves and returns to the list

edge: Recovery of a feed-linked finding also resets the feed factor to 1.
rules: Recovery keeps the case in history; entered in error marks it as a correction.
issues: The log wording differs: "Recovered" here and "Finding entered in error" in the single-pig form against "Record corrected" here.

notes.purpose: Record medicine actually given, to one pig or many, without implying every pig got the same dose. How to reach it: Actions, Health, Record treatment; Finding, Record treatment; or a Health task such as Vaccination.
states: One pig: Details panel only; many: list with a Dose column and a per-pig dose that overrides the shared dose.
From a finding: the condition is fixed and shown.
From a vaccination task: titled "Record vaccination", vaccine list only, no condition chip, Save reads "Save and complete task".
Save disabled until medicine, method, unit and a dose above 0 are set.

elements.name: Medicine / Vaccine
elements.logic: Button; opens the medicine picker.

elements.name: Method
elements.shows: Injection · Oral · Topical · In feed · In water
elements.logic: Select picker.

elements.name: Dose · Unit
elements.shows: Set dose for all / Dose · mL · mg · g
elements.logic: Shared dose, applied to every row; a row can hold its own value.

elements.name: Brand chip
elements.logic: Optional; opens the brand picker with sample brands and "Add a brand".

elements.name: Condition chip
elements.logic: Optional link to a condition from the selected pigs or the whole catalogue; links only to pigs carrying it.

elements.name: Add note chip
elements.logic: Optional.

elements.name: Row state
elements.logic: Only on an invalid row; valid rows show no text.

elements.name: Save
elements.shows: Save · N pigs / Save and complete task
elements.logic: One treatment record per included pig; log "Treatment recorded" or "Vaccination recorded"; a task completes on Save.

controls.does: saves and returns to the list, the finding, or the pig record

edge: A shared dose change clears any per-row overrides.
A task-triggered treatment may prefill the medicine, but the user still confirms (TREATMENT.md; the prototype prefills nothing).
rules: TREATMENT.md: medicine actually administered; shared dose plus per-pig dose overrides; one record per included pig; medicines, methods and units should come from farm configuration.
issues: Medicines, brands and units are a sample list and not farm configuration.
Dose is "per pig" in one place and "for all" in another.
The finding's "Record treatment" and the Health group's "Record treatment" differ only by the fixed condition.

notes.purpose: Choose the medicine (or vaccine). How to reach it: Record treatment, Select medicine.
states: Categories: Antibiotics (2), Pain relief (1), Parasite control (1), Vaccines (2); inside a category the medicines; search across name, category and detail.
Vaccination task: only Vaccines.
No match: "No medicines found. Try another name or category."

elements.name: Category door
elements.logic: Name and count.

elements.name: Medicine row
elements.logic: Name and form; with a search term the category is added in front. A check marks the chosen one.

controls.does: selects it and returns to the form (a changed medicine clears the brand)

edge: The catalogue is a sample, "not a treatment recommendation" (code comment).
issues: Sample names ("Antibiotic A") and "Sample brand A" are placeholders.
